cols.name: Name
cols.hint: Click to sort · right-click for columns

empty: Drop a link here or press “Add”

st.unverified: Complete · not verified (server sent no ETag)
st.changed: The file changed on the server · old part kept
st.foreignPart: The .part file was replaced · GDM leaves it alone
st.diskFull: Not enough disk space (1 GB kept free)
st.sizeExceeded: Larger than the set limit · continue?
st.insecure: The server tried an unsafe route
st.tls: The server's certificate is not valid
st.auth: Login needed or the link expired
st.gone: The file is no longer on the server
st.html: Server sent an HTML page · login needed?
st.timeout: The server is answering too slowly
st.reparse: This folder cannot be used (junction or link)
st.badRange: The server sent wrong data · stopped to protect the file

act.removeDone: Remove all completed from the list

why.blocked: Windows Security or your antivirus removed or refused this file. GDM never gave it its final name. If you trust the source, check Windows Security.
why.unprotected: This folder (exFAT/FAT or a network share) cannot record that the file came from the internet, so Windows will not warn when it is opened. Use an NTFS folder for programs.
why.tls: The connection was refused to protect you. GDM has no “ignore” button.
why.insecure: The server tried to switch from https to http or to a route GDM does not allow. GDM stopped and there is no way around it.

d.title: Details
d.limit: Speed limit for this file (KB/s, 0 = none)

info.title: Download file info
info.note: GDM already started while you choose
info.name: File name

infoMsg.sync-metered: Synchronization waits: the connection is metered
infoMsg.quota-reached: Download quota reached: downloads are paused until the period ends
infoMsg.action-skipped: The shutdown or sleep was cancelled because downloads are still running

banner.restored: The list was restored from backup {{name}} · downloads found on disk were recovered
banner.readonly: This list comes from a newer GDM · opened read-only
banner.pipe: Browsers cannot reach GDM: another program took GDM's pipe name
banner.updReady: Update {{v}} is ready · installs when GDM is idle

set.startupS: Runs quietly in the tray (browsers also start GDM when needed)
set.silentS: Blocked files and decisions are still shown
set.connsS: Starts at 2 and adds more while speed rises
set.info: Show the info dialog for browser downloads
set.infoS: Like IDM: downloading starts while the dialog is open
set.limitS: For hotspots with a data cap
set.catchS: The extension sends only the link, the name and that site's cookie
set.skip: Sites never caught (* = anything, one per line)
set.videoS: Off by default · arrives in P2
set.unpacked: Paste {{page}} in the address bar (copied) › turn on “Developer mode” › drag the “extension” folder GDM opened onto that page
set.updModeS: Automatic: checks daily, downloads in the background, installs when GDM is idle
set.store: Updates come from the Microsoft Store
set.privacyText: GDM has no telemetry, no account and no user ID. The only request GDM makes by itself is the update check (GET latest.json from GitHub), and you can turn it off.
set.clipboardS: Off by default. Reads only links with a file type GDM catches, and skips content marked “exclude from clipboard history” (passwords)
set.attribution: Galaxy Download Manager — Copyright (c) 2026 Golden IQ and Chhit Sungchhay. Licensed under the Reciprocal Public License 1.5. https://github.com/goldeniq-official/Galaxy-Download-Manage-By-GoldenIQ-V1.0
set.supportS: GDM is free for everyone, including businesses, schools and government. Support is voluntary: it unlocks no feature and gives no priority in support or feature decisions.
set.supportScan: Scan this KHQR with your banking app.
set.supportNone: The KHQR image is not in this build yet.
set.hostsS: For servers that refuse many connections (* = any part, e.g. *.example.com)
set.quotaS: At most this many MB in each period, then downloads pause until it ends (0 = off)
set.sidecar: Check the .sha256 file published next to a download
set.sidecarS: From the same site; a wrong hash means the file is never marked complete
set.scan: Scan each finished file with my antivirus program
set.scanS: Optional: GDM runs it with {file} after each download (Windows Security already checks every file)
set.uaSites: Per site (for servers that need a browser's User-Agent)

upd.ready: Version {{v}} is ready · installs when GDM is idle

ob.p1: You can change these later in Settings.
ob.p2: Install the extension so GDM can catch downloads from your browser.
ob.tip: {{force}} + click = force GDM · {{bypass}} + click = let the browser download. Keys can be changed in Settings.
ob.p3: Each one can be changed later.
ob.videoS: A small button over videos on web pages (arrives in P2)
ob.clipS: Catch links you copy (only file types GDM catches; never passwords)
ob.updS: Check daily and install when GDM is idle
ob.fsWarn: This folder is not NTFS ({{fs}}) · Windows cannot warn when you open programs downloaded from the internet

batch.title: Add batch download
batch.pattern: Address with * where the number or letter changes
batch.confirmS: More than 10 000 at once needs your confirmation

e.bad-pattern: Put exactly one * in an http or https address
e.bad-range: From and To must be numbers or single letters, From first
e.too-many: More than 100 000 addresses: make the range smaller

batch.hint: Type an address above; the addresses that will be downloaded are listed here.

imp.title: Import downloads
imp.count: {{n}} downloads found in the file. Nothing is added until you press “Add”.
imp.settings: Also restore settings from this file (safe ones only; queue actions stay off)

e.too-large: The file is larger than 50 MB
e.bad-json: This file is not a GDM export
e.too-many: The file holds too many downloads (at most 100,000 at a time)
e.nothing: No downloads found in this file

ref.title: Refresh download address
ref.wait: GDM opened the download page in your browser. Click the download link there again and GDM catches the new address (it waits up to 10 minutes).
ref.diff: different size: probably a different file
ref.risk: Probably the same file, not verified: the server sent no strong validator
ref.restartS: Start over makes a new download; the old .part file is kept
ref.html: The server sent a web page instead of the file (login needed?)

vid.title: Add video
vid.page: Address of the web page with the video
vid.busy: Looking for the video on this page…

e.drm: This video is protected (DRM). GDM never downloads protected content.
e.live: Live streams are not supported in this version.
e.no-formats: No downloadable video was found on this page.
e.need-component: Video download needs two free programs first.

vid.notice: Video downloads use the free helpers yt-dlp and FFmpeg (~200 MB, once, signature-checked). Only download what you have the right to; DRM-protected video is never downloaded.
vid.install: Set up the video helpers (~200 MB)
vid.hint: Paste the page address and press “Find videos”: the qualities you can download are listed here.

px.systemS: Uses the Windows proxy settings: manual, PAC script or WPAD
px.bypass: Do not use the proxy for (one per line, <local> = local addresses)
px.passS: The password goes to Windows Credential Manager and is never shown again
px.winS: GDM signs in with your Windows account (NTLM/Negotiate); nothing is stored

e.bad-login: Check the address (http or https) and the user name

qs.name: Name
qs.typeS: Synchronization keeps its files and downloads them again when they change on the server
qs.schedS: If you stop the queue yourself, the action when done does not run
qs.date: Once on this date (no day chosen)
qs.retriesS: A failed file moves to the end of the queue
qs.onDoneS: A 60-second countdown with Cancel comes first
qs.forceS: Unsaved work in other programs is lost
qs.wakeS: Only when plugged in (Windows Task Scheduler)
qs.empty: No files in this queue. Right-click a download > Add to queue.

e.program-interpreter: Shells and script hosts (cmd, PowerShell, wscript…) cannot be chosen
e.batch-metachar: An argument for a .bat cannot contain & | < > ^ %
e.bad-args: Arguments are too long or contain control characters

prop.urlS: The file's validator is checked on the next run: a different file stops with “file changed”.

e.has-progress: Only a download that has not started can move to another folder
e.bad-url: This address cannot be used now (stop the download first)

grab.title: Site grabber
grab.avoidS: Links with logout, sign out, delete, remove or unsubscribe are never opened, whatever you type here. The grabber only reads pages (GET); it never fills or sends forms.
grab.keepS: Files go into sub-folders named after the site and its folders
grab.startNowS: Otherwise the files are added paused, so you can start them when you like
grab.subdomains: Explore all subdomains of the main domain
grab.robotsS: Pages the site asks robots not to open are skipped
grab.js: Look for links in JavaScript (use with caution)
grab.jsS: Only plain addresses written in the script text; nothing is run
grab.types: File types to find (comma separated, * allowed)
grab.hideDupS: Files with the same name as one found earlier
grab.limits: Limits: at most 1 000 pages (5 000 maximum), 100 MB of pages, 15 minutes; one page per second per site by default.
grab.more: and {{n}} more (they are added too when selected)
grab.nothing: No file matched the file types

stop.done: Finished: every page in range was explored

e.bad-url: Type an http or https address
e.bad-login: The login name cannot contain : or control characters
e.too-many: Too many files at once (100 000 maximum)
